title: [Game Release] Claim No. 13 — a supernatural desk-horror game about processing lost property
author: Bruno2456
selftext:
I’ve released \*\*Claim No. 13\*\*, a supernatural desk-horror mystery set inside the lost-property office of an abandoned busterminal.  

   

Each case presents an object, inspection points and several claimants with conflicting stories. You must decide whether to return the item, quarantine it or destroy it—and live with the consequences.  

   

The game includes:  

   

  \\- Five story shifts  

  \\- 15 story objects and 24 randomized cases  

  \\- Three endings and an Overtime mode  

  \\- English and Brazilian Portuguese  

  \\- Windows, Linux and macOS versions  

   

  The complete first shift is free to play directly in your browser. The full desktop game is $3.99.  

   

\*\*Play it here:\*\* Claim No. 13 on itch.io:  

\[https://edencompiler.itch.io/claim-no-13\](https://edencompiler.itch.io/claim-no-13)  

   

AI disclosure: AI was used both on art and code extensively.

comments.author: Suspicious_Neck_4069
comments.body: Feel free to use AI for your game, that’s fine, but don’t use it to write your posts, and certainly not for the title. You’re here to talk to real people (and, in your case, promote your game); nobody wants to read obviously AI-generated text (and I say this as someone who supports AI).
